milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate/observe task — the agent must navigate toward and visually identify the barrel block inside the open-front storage shed. Target is the barrel at spawn-relative (0, 1, 5). The agent spawns ~5.0 blocks away (horizontal) facing the barrel, so max_distance=4 requires the agent to walk at least 1 block forward, preventing trivial step-0 completion. facing_tolerance=60 ensures the agent is actively looking toward the barrel.
